import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem graph_cauchy_net
  {α β γ ι : Type*} [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] [UniformSpace γ] [Preorder ι]
  {f : α → β} {g : β → γ} {u : ι → α}
  (hf : UniformContinuous f) (hg : UniformContinuous g) (hu : CauchySeq u) :
  CauchySeq (fun i => (u i, g (f (u i)))) := by
  have hgf : UniformContinuous (g ∘ f) := hg.comp hf
  
  
  have h1 : CauchySeq (fun i => g (f (u i))) := by
    have heq : (fun i => g (f (u i))) = (g ∘ f) ∘ u := rfl
    rw [heq]
    first
    | exact CauchySeq.map hgf hu
    | exact CauchySeq.map hu hgf
    | exact hu.map hgf
    | exact hgf.cauchyMap hu
    | exact Filter.Cauchy.map_uniformContinuous hgf hu
    | exact UniformContinuous.cauchyMap hgf hu
  
  first
  | exact CauchySeq.prod hu h1
  | exact hu.prod h1
  | exact CauchySeq.prodMk hu h1
  | exact Filter.Cauchy.prod hu h1
  | exact hu.prodMap h1
